value.rationale: The complete and natural optimal integer-labeling solution space of a basic graph family is identified as a point, simplex, or product of simplices depending on path length modulo four. The exact optimizer count is a nontrivial solution-degeneracy invariant—especially the squared-binomial regime—which the inspected earlier optimum-weight theorem does not provide. This can serve as a structural base case for weighted caterpillar optimization, independently of broader downstream theorems.
